newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DRB-Hicom head may be announced-company.
newsitem.headline: DRB-Hicom head may be announced-company.

text.p: The new chairman for the DRB-Hicom group could be announced at a news conference on Thursday, a company official told Reuters.
DRB-Hicom was widely expected to name a successor to Yahaya Ahmad, who died in a helicopter crash on Monday, at the news conference scheduled to be held at 5:30 p.m. local time (0930 GMT).
Yahaya had headed DRB-Hicom, the parent of Proton Bhd, Malaysia's national car maker.
"We hope to announce a new chairman at the news conference. We don't want there to be any uncertainties over the stocks," said a DRB-Hicom official. No other details were given.

Shares of nine companies controlled by Yahaya were suspended before the opening of trade on the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Tuesday. The companies include Proton, Diversified Resources Bhd (DRB) and Hicom Holdings Bhd.
Analysts have speculated that the new chairman will be Saleh Sulong, currently the deputy chairman of Proton. DRB-Hicom declined to comment on the speculation.
